description: Android Java class 'ScannerFragment' that performs Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) scanning, manages scan lifecycle, and displays results in a list.

classes.name: ScannerFragment
classes.description: A fragment that scans for BLE advertisements, manages scan lifecycle, and displays results.

classes.name: SampleScanCallback
classes.description: Custom callback for BLE scan results, updates UI and handles errors.

methods.name: setBluetoothAdapter
methods.description: Sets the BluetoothAdapter and initializes BluetoothLeScanner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets options menu, and creates adapter and handler.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view and sets the list adapter.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures list view and triggers initial scan.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggers scanning.

methods.name: startScanning
methods.description: Starts BLE scan with filters and settings, sets a timer to stop.

methods.name: stopScanning
methods.description: Stops BLE scan and updates UI.

methods.name: buildScanFilters
methods.description: Creates list of scan filters based on service UUID.

methods.name: buildScanSettings
methods.description: Creates scan settings with low power mode.
